notes: kb/Work PB5209 LANDED: the Format 2 sequence data-name-1 [qualifiers] [({subscript} ...)] [reference-modifier] with ALL as the subscript in a function argument compiles and runs at --std 85 (IntrinsicBinder.TryBindAllArgument reads the trailing modifier, direct or after OF/IN qualifiers); witness pb5209_all_subscript_reference_modified_85 (TE OF TT (ALL) (2:1) gives H). The row's earlier reading: SHARED QUESTION Q1 applied. The identifier format prints data-name-1 [qualifiers] [({subscript} ...)] [reference-modifier]; with ALL as a subscript in a function argument (SR7, GR3a) the sequence is legal and is refused COBOL2363. Qualification by cd-name, file-name and report-name, the ordering refusals and format 1 held under the refuter's probes; only this combination fails, so PARTIAL. kb/Work PB5209 holds the defect (code read: held-85/set2/decisions.json).

next.reason: 1985 (§1985:IV.4.3.8.5.2, as Amendment 1 rewrote it) has two formats: "function-identifier-1", and data-name-1 with IN/OF qualifiers, the last of which may be cd-name-1, file-name-1 or report-name-1, then "[({subscript} … )] [reference-modifier]". 2023 keeps format 1 and carries format 2 in three formats: "Format 2 (qualified-data-name-with-subscripts)" and "identifier-1 reference-modifier-1" (§2023:8.4.3.1.2), "qualified-data-name-1 [ ( subscript … ) ]" (§2023:8.4.2.3.2) and "data-name-1 [ data-qualifier ] … [ file-report-qualifier ]" (§2023:8.4.2.2.2). A case removed: the file-report-qualifier names only file-name-1 and report-name-1, so a data-name qualified by a cd-name, legal in 1985, is refused. Cases added: the reference-modifier follows any identifier-1, and formats 4 to 11 are new, from "Format 4 (inline-method-invocation)" to "Format 11 (qualified-report-counter)".
